details.description: Elevate your refreshment experience with the bold and exhilarating Mountain Dew cold drink. Bursting with a captivating citrus flavour, this 750ml bottle is the perfect companion for your daring adventures. Celebrate the spirit of youth and rediscover your adventurous side with the crisp, fizzy taste that invigorates the senses. Deeply rooted in a brand DNA of daring challenges and a 'can-do' attitude, Mountain Dew embodies the rebellious and wild spirit of the young at heart. Open a bottle and let the refreshing, high-energy citrus notes transport you to a world of excitement and possibility. Whether you're seeking an extra boost for your next outdoor escapade or simply want to share the experience with friends, this Mountain Dew is the ideal choice to elevate your refreshment and unleash your inner thrill-seeker.
details.ingredients: Carbonated Water, Sugar (11.7%), Acidity Regulators (330, 331), Preservative (211), Caffeine, Stabiliser (445)
